subject.title: feat(onboard): recommendations store with once-semantics and self-naming bootstrap

question: Should OpenClaw permanently retain a singleton onboarding recommendation offer and suppress future discovery/prompts after acknowledgement, with refresh deferred to a future explicit command?
rationale: This PR creates a persistent user-facing onboarding and privacy contract, including once-only prompting and future refresh behavior, that tests alone cannot choose.

options.title: Accept the once-only contract
options.body: Approve the shared-state retention and explicit-future-refresh direction, contingent on final-head real behavior proof.

options.title: Require an explicit reset design first
options.body: Keep the PR open until the product contract includes the supported user-facing way to revisit or reset accepted recommendations.

recommendation.title: Accept the once-only contract
recommendation.body: Approve the shared-state retention and explicit-future-refresh direction, contingent on final-head real behavior proof.
